name: code-review-max
description: Max-effort, recall-mode code review as a Kiro workflow (kiro-cli 2.26.0+, KAS engine) for native Windows with no Python: eight finder angles in parallel, one fresh session per candidate verification, a gap sweep, re-votes on unstable verdicts, then ranked findings and postable Conventional Comments. Deterministic bookkeeping runs in crtool.mjs on the node.exe kiro-cli already ships for KAS.
